'''Arias''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Originally a [[Jedi Consular]] before he achieved the rank of Master, Arias was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. From his small base on the Lower Promenade, he taught visiting Jedi Consulars new skills.<ref name="TOR" />
